gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/packages/cli/src/program.ts)

Report the tools, the unchecked files, and what changed in the repository after init.

```text
gspot doctor [options]
```

## Options

| Flag         | Meaning                                                                 |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--version`  | Print the version and nothing else                                      |
| `--json`     | Print the documented JSON object instead of text                        |
| `--quiet`    | Print failures only                                                     |
| `--verbose`  | Print every command with its arguments and every ignore with its reason |
| `--no-color` | No color in the output                                                  |
| `-C <dir>`   | Run as if started in that directory                                     |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command                                                |
